name_zh: 石田三成/关原/三成判断/三敬茶/大名平衡
name_en: Ishida Mitsunari/Sekigahara/Mitsunari Judgment/Three Bowls Tea/Daimyo Balance
description_zh: 石田三成 (1560-1600) 丰臣政权五奉行之首，关原之战西军主帅。早年以'三敬茶'侍奉秀吉展现极致观察力与共情，推行'太阁检地'与'三成判断'确立行政理性，关原之战虽败犹显大名平衡术与情报决策。
description_en: Ishida Mitsunari (1560-1600) Head of Toyotomi's Five Commissioners, Western Army commander at Sekigahara. Early 'Three Bowls of Tea' serving Hideyoshi demonstrated supreme observational empathy; implemented Taiko Land Survey and 'Mitsunari Judgments' establishing administrative rationality; Sekigahara defeat still revealed daimyo balance mastery and intelligence-driven decision-making.
reason_zh: 三成代表'技术官僚型武将'如何通过极致观察共情(三敬茶)、制度建设(检地/判断)、情报博弈(关原布局)在乱世构建秩序。其悲剧性失败反而证明：纯理性行政在非理性武力面前的结构性脆弱，以及'三敬茶'式微观共情如何成为宏观决策的认知基石。
reason_en: Mitsunari represents how 'technocratic warrior' built order through supreme observational empathy (Three Bowls Tea), institutional engineering (land survey/judgments), and intelligence games (Sekigahara layout). His tragic failure proves structural fragility of pure rational administration facing irrational force, and how 'Three Bowls Tea' micro-empathy becomes cognitive foundation for macro decisions.
steps_zh: 复盘三敬茶：热/温/凉三杯茶背后的体温感知与需求预判
解析太阁检地：从土地生产力测算到税制标准化的制度理性
研读三成判断：以证据为中心的行政裁决如何确立程序正义
推演关原布局：情报收集/大名劝说/地形选择的博弈树与风险对冲
总结三成模式：微观共情→制度理性→情报决策的认知闭环，及其在非理性武力面前的结构性失效
steps_en: Review Three Bowls Tea: body temp sensing & need anticipation behind hot/warm/cool tea
Analyze Taiko Land Survey: from productivity measurement to tax standardization institutional rationality
Study Mitsunari Judgments: evidence-centered administrative adjudication establishing procedural justice
Reenact Sekigahara Layout: intelligence gathering/daimyo persuasion/terrain selection game tree & risk hedging
Summarize Mitsunari Pattern: micro-empathy → institutional rationality → intelligence decision cognitive loop, and its structural failure against irrational force
expected_zh: 掌握'三敬茶式观察共情'如何转化为'检地式制度理性'与'关原式情报决策'的认知升级路径；理解技术官僚在乱世中的建构性贡献与结构性悲剧；评估三成模式对现代行政裁决、情报决策、组织共情文化的双重启示。
expected_en: Master cognitive upgrade path from 'Three Bowls Tea observational empathy' to 'Land Survey institutional rationality' to 'Sekigahara intelligence decision'; understand technocrat's constructive contribution and structural tragedy in chaos; evaluate Mitsunari pattern's dual lessons for modern administrative adjudication, intelligence decision-making, and organizational empathy culture.
case_zh: 1590 三敬茶得秀吉赏识；1594 太阁检地确立税制；1598 三成判断确立程序正义；1600 关原之战败亡。三敬茶-检地-判断-关原认知闭环永存。
case_en: 1590 Three Bowls Tea won Hideyoshi's favor; 1594 Taiko Land Survey established tax system; 1598 Mitsunari Judgments established procedural justice; 1600 Sekigahara defeat. Three Bowls Tea-Survey-Judgment-Sekigahara cognitive loop endures.
intellectual_tradition: Sengoku Technocratic Administration / Japanese Bureaucratic Rationality
cross_cultural_impact: Three Bowls Tea empathy; land survey institutionalization; evidence-based administrative judgment; intelligence-driven strategic decision; technocrat tragedy
